issues: 新旧场景都是通用灰阶 FakeDashboard 骨架，没有任何可读内容，像线框稿
窗内只有灰色 dashboard 缩略 + 两张灰卡，"穿窗进入那张卡的世界"语义不成立
角落残留调试字「Scene B」，被浮卡压住一半
全片灰白无强调色，穿窗完成后的结尾帧不是一张完整画面
changes: look 换成 porcelain：外景重做成为镜头设计的 Workspace 主页——96px 问候标题 + 3×2 空间卡，每张有程序化封面（同心圆/柱/点阵/斜纹/弧/波形）、40px 标题、32px 元信息
语义闭环：目标卡「Northwind Forecast」的钴蓝波形封面就是窗内世界的样子——深钴蓝空间、同款三道波形放大成地貌
窗内严守 2 层视差：远景玻璃预测面板（64px 标题、实线历史 + 虚线预测区间 + TODAY 标线）系数 0.08，近景两枚指标浮卡（+18.4% / 94% confidence 环）系数 0.3，落点压住面板两角
运动：目标卡抬起作预备、邻卡退暗 18% → 40f bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) 穿窗，卡面前 28% 行程渐隐 → 面积图随 t 画完 → 66f 完成后 8f 缓停，静止 hold 66f
issuesEn: Both scenes were generic grey FakeDashboard skeletons with no readable content, like wireframes
Inside the window there was only a grey dashboard thumbnail and two grey cards, so 'stepping into that card's world' did not read
A leftover debug label 'Scene B' sat in the corner, half covered by a floating card
Grey and white throughout with no accent, and the post-portal end frame was not a finished picture
changesEn: Porcelain look: the outer scene is a purpose-built Workspace home with a 96px greeting and a 3x2 grid of space cards, each with a procedural cover (rings, bars, dots, stripes, arcs, waves), a 40px title and 32px meta

Closed semantic loop: the target card Northwind Forecast has a cobalt wave cover, and the world inside the portal looks like that cover, a deep cobalt space with the same three waves enlarged into a landscape

Strictly two parallax layers inside: a far glass forecast panel (64px title, solid history, dashed forecast band, TODAY marker) at factor 0.08 and two near metric chips (+18.4% and a 94% confidence ring) at 0.3, landing over the panel's corners

Motion: the target lifts as anticipation while neighbours dim 18%, a 40f bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) portal, the card face fades in the first 28% of travel, the area chart draws with t, then an 8f settle after 66f and a 66f still hold
